name: phasetwo
description: A unified Keycloak skill that routes requests to the right guidance for configuring Keycloak/Phase Two extension behaviors: passwordless login by magic link, passkey-only WebAuthn login, corporate/enterprise SSO by email domain, social login and enterprise identity-provider federation (Entra ID, Okta, Auth0, and more), organization-membership login restriction for both local and federated logins, and Phase Two cluster/deployment provisioning.
